scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev -w @altrimar/api" "npm run dev -w @altrimar/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @altrimar/shared && npm run build --workspaces --if-present
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @altrimar/shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test: npm run build -w @altrimar/shared && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
scripts.validate: npm run test && npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run build
